candidate_set_provenance.statement: Phase 4 OOF errors informed the source-robustness objective and ceramic specialist family. A read-only fixed-C development pre-screen informed the bounded view set. Nested evaluation reduces direct tuning reuse but cannot make Phase 5 an unbiased final estimate; only the sealed test can do that.
candidate_set_provenance.prohibited_adaptation: Phase 4 per-image error membership must not be used as a training feature, hard-negative weight, or fold-specific rule.

source_weighting.class_normalization: normalize raw weights within each training class so every class has equal total mass, then normalize global mean weight to one
source_weighting.fit_scope: recompute group sizes and normalizers using training rows only

ceramic_specialist.training: fit the same selected feature family, C, and source exponent on training-only ceramic rows
ceramic_specialist.prediction: preserve the base ceramic probability mass and replace only its conditional three-class distribution with the specialist distribution
ceramic_specialist.forbidden: no learned gate, blend grid, per-example Phase 4 error routing, or threshold selection

nested_evaluation.outer_rule: hold out one canonical cv_fold; never use it for candidate, C, source exponent, specialist, or tie-break selection
nested_evaluation.inner_rule: on the remaining four canonical folds, create pooled inner OOF predictions by holding out each fold once and fitting on the other three
nested_evaluation.outer_prediction_rule: refit the selected inner procedure on all four outer-training folds and predict the outer fold exactly once
nested_evaluation.full_development_selection: after nested reporting, apply the identical five-fold OOF selection rule once on all development rows to freeze the Phase 6 candidate
nested_evaluation.interpretation: nested OOF estimates the adaptive Phase 5 procedure but remains development-informed because Phase 4 diagnostics shaped the candidate family

selection_rule.group_recall: for each true class, average correctness within each source-atomic group, then average group accuracies within that class
selection_rule.source_group_balanced_accuracy: mean of the five class group recalls
selection_rule.ceramic_worst_group_recall: minimum group recall across Opishnyan, Bubnivka, and Kosiv
selection_rule.robustness_score: harmonic mean of source_group_balanced_accuracy and ceramic_worst_group_recall
tie_breakers: higher minimum inner-fold source-group balanced accuracy
selection_rule.specialist_selection: compare no-specialist and three-way specialist only after the base configuration is selected, using the same eligibility, score, and tie rule

stability_rule.base_recipe: the full-development base winner must be within the robustness-score tie window of the best base recipe in at least four of five outer inner searches
stability_rule.interpretation: failure means recipe instability and prevents promotion even if aggregate metrics are high

diagnostic_slice_definitions.challenging_opishnyan: true Opishnyan rows in the hard-three cohorts or with blank source_atomic_cohort_ids
diagnostic_slice_definitions.large_named_source: nonblank source_atomic_cohort_ids with at least 20 development images
